newsitem.title: INDIA: India says lost 15 mln working days in 1996.
newsitem.headline: India says lost 15 mln working days in 1996.

text.p: India lost close to 15 million working days last year, mainly due to industrial disputes, a small improvement from 16 million days lost in 1995 and about 21 million in 1994, the government said on Monday.

"The government maintains a close and continuous watch over the industrial relations situation in the country," Labour Minister M. Arunachalam told the upper house of parliament in a written statement.
India's archaic labour laws are often criticised by foreign businessmen, who want the country to introduce a Western style hire-and-fire regime as a condition for boosting investments.
Arunchalam said 228 industrial units closed down in 1994, 183 in 1995 and 149 in 1996, but did not say if the shutdowns were linked to labour disputes.
